payload.rationale: This document is a Phase 2 E2E test that directly extends the existing Position_OmittedIdSlugResolution (how the pipeline derives identity when an explicit id is omitted) and belongs to the Narrative_ContentDerivedIdentityResolution (content-derived record identity generation). The Architecture strata frames the ingestion workflow and persistence mechanics this test exercises. The two expressions capture the prior assertions this document reproduces: submission without an id field and the requirement to produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback. The Sample_1SampleMemoryWithDistinctiveHeading is the source sample this Phase 2 test derives from. I deliberately did not expand ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst — it concerns a consulting methodology decision unrelated to the id-derivation pipeline this document tests.
